archetype: SWISS & TACTICAL ENTERPRISE FINANCE (Precision, High-Contrast, Data-Dense)
emotional_tone: Authoritative, bulletproof, highly focused finance operations control tower
disclaimer_text: Disclaimer: This tool provides automated review assistance and exception flagging only. It is not formal tax advice and does not perform automatic posting to SAP or GST portals.

typography.font_pairing_strategy: Precision Display Sans (Headings) + Clean Humanist Sans (Body) + Crisp Monospace (GSTINs, Invoices, Amounts, Discrepancies)

scale.card_header: text-sm sm:text-base font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400

colors.theme_mode: Dark-first with ultra-high contrast dark slate background (#080C14) and crisp light theme support toggle

layout_and_grid.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Finance Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4 sm:gap-6)
layout_and_grid.kpi_cards_layout: grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3 sm:gap-4 mb-6
layout_and_grid.stepper_wizard: 5-Step sequential progress header (1. Upload Files -> 2. Map Columns -> 3. Match Settings -> 4. Review Exceptions -> 5. Export Report)
layout_and_grid.table_layout: Dense tabular layout with fixed headers, sticky column actions, sorting, pagination, multi-filter pill row, and row highlight on hover

key_components.name: Header & Mode Selector
key_components.description: Top sticky bar with SAP Finance Recon badge, demo dataset toggle, light/dark switch, recent jobs dropdown, and explicit disclaimer tooltip

key_components.name: Stepper Wizard Progress
key_components.description: Visual 5-step progress pill bar displaying current step (Upload, Map, Reconcile, Review, Export) with interactive back/next actions

key_components.name: Dual File Dropzones (SAP & GSTR-2B)
key_components.description: Side-by-side dropzones for SAP Export File (CSV/XLSX) and GSTR-2B Purchase Register file, with drag-and-drop, sample template download, and parsed summary preview

key_components.name: Smart Column Mapping Engine
key_components.description: Interactive table mapping SAP and GSTR-2B columns to standard schema (GSTIN, Invoice No, Invoice Date, Taxable Value, Tax Amount, Vendor Name) with auto-alias detection confidence badges (High/Medium/Manual)

key_components.name: Matching Engine Configuration
key_components.description: Settings panel for Amount Tolerance (₹0.00, ₹1.00, ₹10.00, custom ₹), Date Format parser, Fuzzy Invoice Number matching toggle, and GSTIN casing normalizer

key_components.name: KPI Summary Dashboard Cards
key_components.description: 6 High-impact KPI tiles: Total Records, Matched (Green), Missing in GSTR-2B (Red), Amount Mismatches (Purple), Duplicates (Pink), Records Requiring Review (Amber)

key_components.name: Exception Review Queue & Line-Item Inspector
key_components.description: Filterable, searchable data grid showing source value vs comparison value, calculated variance, status badge, flagged reason description, and row detail drawer

key_components.name: Export & Audit Summary Section
key_components.description: Excel/CSV export generator with options for Full Reconciliation Report, Exception-Only Report, and Audit Log CSV summary

image_urls.description: Senior Tax & Finance Operations Specialist Avatar

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All cards scale slightly with border glow transition (transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease). Explicit text colors set on hover.
motion_and_interactions.button_microinteractions: Active state scale-95, shadow-lg glow effect on primary action buttons.
motion_and_interactions.progress_animations: Smooth progress bar fill when matching engine runs (Framer motion or Tailwind transition).
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; high contrast APCA compliant badges and text.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid: MANDATORY on every single interactive element, select dropdown option, input field, modal, button, tab, and card.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.hover_contrast: ALWAYS explicitly define hover text colors (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white). NEVER rely on transparent text inheritance.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.disclaimer_banner: MUST render prominent disclaimer banner stating 'Review assistance only - Not tax advice or automatic SAP posting'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.fictional_demo_mode: Provide 'Load Demo SAP & GSTR-2B Data' button so evaluators can instantly test complete flow without uploading files.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.icons: Use lucide-react icons exclusively (FileSpreadsheet, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, ArrowRight, Upload, RefreshCw, Download, Sliders, ShieldAlert, FileText, Search, Filter).
